clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, Tharnariun Treetender seeks a way to study the sick thistle bears and find a cure. His trap calms them long enough to bring them to his camp.

Tharnariun Treetender made a calming trap to study the sick thistle bears. Across Darkshore, a mysterious affliction has left the animals increasingly frenzied and violent. Tharnariun hopes to cure them rather than see them killed. Set on the ground, Tharnariun's Hope casts a soothing light. A rabid thistle bear that crosses it grows calm for a time and can follow a traveler back to Tharnariun's camp for treatment.
